articles.title: The Broker’s Guide to Winning Certainty in Bridge Lending
articles.narrative: This article, published by Atlas Invest, serves as a guide for commercial mortgage brokers and capital advisors seeking reliable bridge lending partners. It highlights the importance of speed and certainty in bridge lending, outlining Atlas Invest's capabilities in providing same-day term sheets and funding in as few as seven days for eligible submissions. The guide details the types of properties and loan amounts Atlas Invest considers, emphasizing its focus on value-add deals in residential investment real estate.

articles.title: Podcast: Using AI to Make Better CRE Acquisition & Underwriting Decisions
articles.narrative: This podcast features Steven Song, founder and CEO of Diald, an AI-powered decision intelligence platform for commercial real estate. Song discusses how AI can enhance CRE acquisition and underwriting decisions, arguing that while human judgment remains crucial, AI can help identify overlooked local signals and contextual risks. He highlights how AI can improve efficiency by killing bad deals earlier in the process and upgrading the analyst's role, rather than replacing it.

articles.title: Developer Iadisernia Lands Mezz Loan to Finish Hallandale, Fla., Condo Tower
articles.narrative: Developer Giuseppe Iadisernia has secured a $50 million mezzanine loan from Cottonwood Group to complete a 250-unit condominium tower in Hallandale Beach, FL. This financing follows a $112 million construction loan provided by S3 Capital last year for the 25-story tower, which is part of the larger 10-acre Oasis mixed-use development. The project, expected to be completed next year, also includes commercial office and retail space.

data_points.address: 1000 East Hallandale Beach Boulevard, Hallandale Beach, FL
data_points.notable_features: 25-story condo tower within a 10-acre mixed-use development, approximately one mile from the beach.
data_points.project_notes: The project previously secured a $112 million construction loan from S3 Capital in 2025. The broader development includes 35,000 square feet of office space and 60,000 square feet of retail space, completed in 2024. Condo prices range from $580,000 to $3.5 million.

articles.title: Dov Hertz Offloads Major Staten Island Industrial Site for $167M
articles.narrative: Jadian Capital has acquired a 53-acre industrial outdoor storage (IOS) site on Staten Island for $167 million from Dov Hertz's Kadima Industrial Partners. The property, located on the island's west shore, is fully leased and features both a waterfront dock and train access. This transaction highlights the strong demand from both users and capital for well-located IOS sites with excellent infrastructure proximity.

data_points.address: 1900 and 1800 South Avenue, Staten Island, NY
data_points.notable_features: Features a waterfront dock and train access, fully leased to a strong tenant mix.
data_points.project_notes: Seller previously acquired the two sites in 2020 and 2021 for a total of $79 million and invested approximately $10 million in capital projects.

articles.title: Jaime Lee Joins Kennedy Wilson After Two Decades at L.A. Powerhouse Jamison
articles.narrative: Jaime Lee, formerly CEO of Jamison, has joined Kennedy Wilson as Senior Managing Director of Capital Markets and Investments. In her new role, Lee will focus on capital formation, investor relations, and global investment strategies for the Beverly Hills-based firm, which manages approximately $37 billion in assets. Her move follows a two-decade tenure at Jamison, where she was instrumental in expanding its portfolio and establishing it as a prominent office-to-residential developer in Los Angeles. Lee is particularly optimistic about the multifamily sector, citing constrained supply and strong housing demand as key drivers for long-term fundamentals.

articles.title: CBRE Arranges $45.8 Million Loan for Refinancing of Scottsdale Towne Center
articles.narrative: CBRE has secured a $45.8 million, five-year, fixed-rate, full-term interest-only loan for the refinancing of Scottsdale Towne Center, a nearly fully leased power center in Scottsdale, Arizona. The owner acquired the property in 2021.

data_points.address: 15444 N. Frank Lloyd Wright Blvd., Scottsdale, AZ
data_points.project_notes: Property was acquired by the current owner in 2021.

articles.title: CBL Properties Closes $50.6M Sale of York Town Center in Pennsylvania
articles.narrative: CBL Properties and its joint venture partner have sold York Town Center, an open-air regional retail center in York, Pennsylvania, for $50.6 million. The transaction was completed at an 8.5 percent capitalization rate. The center features a strong tenant mix across 297,000 square feet.

data_points.project_notes: Transaction completed at an 8.5 percent capitalization rate.

articles.title: Benderson Acquires Three Properties Totaling 400,000 SF in Florida
articles.narrative: Benderson Development has expanded its portfolio with the acquisition of three retail properties totaling 400,000 square feet along Florida's west coast. The portfolio includes Granada Plaza, a Publix-anchored center in Dunedin; Venice Market Place, a shopping center in Venice; and a building in Estero occupied by a home improvement retailer.

data_points.project_notes: The portfolio includes Granada Plaza in Dunedin, Venice Market Place in Venice, and a building in Estero.

articles.title: SRS Real Estate Partners Brokers $6.2M Sale of 31,086 SF Retail Property in Las Vegas
articles.narrative: SRS Real Estate Partners has facilitated the all-cash sale of a 31,086-square-foot retail property in Las Vegas for $6.2 million. The asset, which has been occupied by a discount apparel retailer for over four decades, was sold by a West Coast private seller to a private investor from California. The transaction closed at a 6.5 percent capitalization rate.

data_points.address: 2420 E. Desert Inn Road, Las Vegas, NV

articles.title: Portman Acquires Land in North Houston, Receives Construction Financing for 714,339 SF Industrial Project
articles.narrative: Portman has acquired land and secured construction financing for Gateway 1960, a 714,339-square-foot industrial project in North Houston. The development will feature three buildings with speculative office space, LED lighting, and dock-high loading doors. Construction is slated to commence this month and conclude in the third quarter of 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Project will include a 440,323-square-foot cross-dock structure, a 157,723-square-foot front-load building, and a 116,293-square-foot rear-load facility, all with speculative office space, LED lighting, and dock-high loading doors.

articles.title: Incentives play a key role in Liberty, Missouri’s, industrial growth
articles.narrative: The city of Liberty, Missouri, has prioritized economic development by actively pursuing private investment and jobs, utilizing tax incentives and established programs to attract targeted industrial and manufacturing companies. This strategy has resulted in approximately $650 million in projects, adding over 6 million square feet of industrial space and more than 4,000 jobs to the area. The city's clear, predictable incentive programs and collaborative approach with developers and businesses are key factors in its success, providing certainty and agility in a competitive industrial market.

articles.title: Kidder Mathews expands into Dallas with hire of six brokers
articles.narrative: Kidder Mathews, a Western U.S.-based commercial real estate firm, has expanded into Dallas, Texas, by hiring six new brokers, marking its first entry into the Texas market. The new Dallas office will be led by former Edge Capital Markets co-founders Mart Martindale, Brandon Beeson, and Wilson Stafford, who bring extensive experience in investment sales and capital markets across various property types. The firm plans to further expand its service offerings in Dallas-Fort Worth to include Asset Services and Valuation Advisory teams, building on strong performance in these areas.

people.title: Senior Vice President, Managing Director, and Shareholder

articles.title: Apricus Realty Capital acquires 53,100-square-foot IOS property in San Antonio
articles.narrative: Apricus Realty Capital, in partnership with ABR Capital Partners, has acquired an industrial outdoor storage (IOS) property in San Antonio, marking its first investment in this market and expanding its Texas IOS portfolio. The fully occupied 53,100-square-foot facility, located on 4.3 acres, is strategically positioned near San Antonio International Airport with excellent highway access. Apricus plans to implement capital improvements to enhance the property's functionality and institutional quality.

data_points.notable_features: Located adjacent to San Antonio International Airport with direct access to major interstates and highways; features crane-served warehouse space, maintenance facilities, a concrete storage yard, and multiple drive-in loading positions.
data_points.project_notes: Acquired in partnership with ABR Capital Partners as part of a programmatic joint venture focused on IOS and infill industrial aggregation.

articles.title: NAI Robert Lynn closes pair of industrial leases totaling 150,000 square feet in San Antonio
articles.narrative: NAI Robert Lynn represented two tenants, M Padel and Socceroof, in securing a pair of industrial leases totaling 150,000 square feet in Northeast San Antonio. The two former distribution buildings will be converted into a combined sports and recreation destination, marking the first Texas location for both brands and a significant expansion of their offerings.

data_points.address: 6558 E. Campus Drive, San Antonio, TX
data_points.notable_features: Two former distribution buildings to be converted into a sports and recreation destination offering tennis, padel, and indoor soccer.

articles.title: The Boulder Group closes sale of CVS in Richmond
articles.narrative: The Boulder Group facilitated the sale of a single-tenant net-leased CVS pharmacy in Richmond, Texas, for $4.02 million. The 10,200-square-foot property, built in 2016, is situated on 1.9 acres and benefits from a triple-net lease with approximately 15 years remaining and ten 5-year renewal options. The transaction involved a West Coast-based investor as the seller and an East Coast-based firm as the buyer.

data_points.notable_features: Located on FM 723 corridor with high traffic counts, near State Highway 99 and Westpark Tollway. Subject to a triple net (NNN) lease with approximately 15 years remaining and ten 5-year renewal options.

articles.market_intelligence: The property is located within the Houston-The Woodlands-Sugar Land metropolitan statistical area, which is the fifth largest MSA in the United States with a population of over 7 million people. The population within five miles of the property is approximately 135,553 people, and the median household income in the surrounding 77406 ZIP code is approximately $143,000. Richmond and neighboring Fulshear are among the fastest-growing communities in the United States, with Fulshear growing at approximately 14 percent per year.

articles.title: Machine Investment Group Closes Second Fund at Hard Cap of $350M
articles.narrative: Machine Investment Group has successfully closed its second flagship investment vehicle, Machine Real Estate Fund II, at its hard cap of $350 million in primary commitments, with an additional $120 million raised in co-investments. The New York City-based real estate investment platform focuses on opportunistic, distressed, and special situations across the U.S. The fund garnered support from a diverse group of institutional investors, surpassing its debut fund which closed in 2022 with $246 million in primary commitments. The successful fundraising, particularly in a challenging environment for middle-market managers, underscores investor confidence in Machine Investment Group's diversified strategy.

data_points.project_notes: Fund II raised an additional $120 million in co-investments. The debut fund, Machine Real Estate Fund I, closed in 2022 with $246 million in primary commitments and $208 million in co-investments.

articles.title: Century 21 Redevelopment Adds Burlington, National Grocer to Tenant Roster
articles.narrative: MCB Real Estate and Osiris Ventures have secured two major retail leases at Century Marketplace, a $130 million mixed-use redevelopment in Brooklyn's Bay Ridge neighborhood. A national grocery anchor and Burlington have signed leases totaling 60,112 square feet, bringing the 120,000-square-foot project to 65% pre-leased. The project aims to revitalize a key commercial corridor by introducing high-quality retail options to the dense Southwest Brooklyn market.

data_points.notable_features: First national grocer to serve the immediate Southwest Brooklyn trade area.
data_points.project_notes: Redevelopment of the 14-lot Century 21 department store assemblage.

articles.title: Multi-Tenant Corona del Mar Retail Sells Above Asking Price
articles.narrative: A multi-tenant retail property located at 2515 E. Coast Highway in Corona del Mar has been sold for $13.7 million, exceeding its asking price by $700,000. The transaction, arranged by Coastal Commercial and Marcus & Millichap, attracted significant interest and multiple competitive bids from high-net-worth private investors in Orange County. The property's strong appeal was attributed to its prime frontage along Pacific Coast Highway, valuable onsite parking, and a configuration of smaller commercial spaces that offer potential for future rent maximization.

data_points.address: 2515 E. Coast Highway, Corona del Mar, CA
data_points.notable_features: Features incredible frontage along Pacific Coast Highway and approximately 20 onsite parking spaces.

articles.title: Walker & Dunlop Arranges Financing for Stamford Residential Conversion
articles.narrative: Walker & Dunlop has secured a $74.5 million loan for the acquisition and redevelopment of The Caspian, a luxury condominium project in Stamford, CT. The financing, provided by an affiliate of Apollo Global Management, will facilitate the conversion of an existing 241,000-square-foot waterfront office building into 63 luxury residences. This project is strategically positioned to address the significant demand for new waterfront residential product in the supply-constrained Fairfield and Westchester counties.

data_points.notable_features: Waterfront location with a 57-slip marina, private rooftop terraces, and structured parking.
data_points.project_notes: Conversion of an existing seven-story office building into luxury condominium residences.

articles.title: Sixty Beverly Hills Hotel Heads Back To Special Servicing
articles.narrative: The Sixty Beverly Hills Hotel is facing significant financial distress, with its $40 million loan transferred to special servicing due to impending default. This situation highlights ongoing challenges in the hospitality sector, particularly for properties with substantial debt obligations.

data_points.project_notes: Loan transferred to special servicing due to default issues.

articles.title: Coconut Grove Office Flipped For $15M Gain After One Year
articles.narrative: An office property in Coconut Grove, FL, was recently sold, generating a $15 million profit for the seller after only ten months of ownership.

data_points.notable_features: The sale generated a significant profit for the seller in a short ownership period.

articles.title: The Fast-Food Exec Taking Her Real Estate Talents To The Looksmaxxing Era
articles.narrative: Anne Goldman, a former fast-food executive, has transitioned her real estate expertise to Image Studios, a move that highlights a broader industry trend from traditional fast-food retail to health and wellness concepts. This shift underscores the increasing demand for commercial spaces that cater to personal care and beauty services.

articles.title: D.C.'s Office Market Is Getting A Makeover
articles.narrative: Washington D.C.'s office market is undergoing a significant transformation, with property owners investing substantial capital into renovations. This trend is driven by a strong demand for high-quality office spaces, as landlords seek to modernize their assets to attract and retain tenants in a competitive environment.

articles.title: Industrial Outdoor Storage Investor Continues Buying Spree In Metro Atlanta
articles.narrative: Alterra IOS has expanded its industrial outdoor storage (IOS) portfolio in the Atlanta metropolitan area with the acquisition of additional properties. This move signifies the investor's continued focus on strengthening its presence in the region's growing industrial market.
